name: preview-card-2b
title: Preview Card 2b: Inset top, flat bottom
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The 5px top and side inset from 1a, with the flat divider and footer from 1b.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
